d: Samajvadi parti ke varishth neta aazam khan ki rajniti ko samajhna aasan nahin hai. unke samarthakon ke lie vah ek bebak aur sangharshashil neta hain, to aalochkon ke lie unki chhavi dhruvikran karne vale sanpradayik neta ki hai. panch sal se jyada jel men bitane ke bad bahar aae aazam khan se hamari mulakat inhin gutthiyon ko samajhne ka jariya bani.
